verdict.rationale: OpenHands ships an official 'Software Agent SDK' — a composable Python library for building agents that work with code, with extensive documented guides (custom agents, custom tools, agent settings, condensers, ACP integration, agent server API with OpenAPI spec). This constitutes a genuine official SDK, well-documented with first-party guides and a live OpenAPI schema. Missing for 10: independent/community corroboration of real-world SDK adoption and multi-language SDK support (appears Python-only).
